topic.title: What if the Sahara turned green again?

shape.name: The cycle
shape.beats: hook: the what-if about a place -> it already happened, again and again -> what drives it on the map -> what the place looked like last time -> the catch: who far away would feel it -> payoff: when it comes round again -> loop
shape.why: a what-if whose answer is that nature runs it on a timetable: the story is a cycle, not a single change
